r1_carry_forward.method: Canonical JSON (sort_keys, UTF-8) of the 75 keys whose values are identical in the pristine snapshot and the current target; hashed in both files.
r1_carry_forward.statement: The 75 unchanged keys are byte-identical to the target audited in chrome25-fr-a1; R1 accuracy/idiom/register/glossary verdicts carry forward for them without re-audit.

findings.verification: All three now contain U+202F immediately followed by ':' with no second space (ascii: 'Dossier de travail\u202f: {name}', 'Modèle\u202f: {label}', 'Dépenses et contexte\u202f: {label}'). The rest of the fr locale uses 249 occurrences (219 distinct values) of U+202F+':' and zero of U+202F+space+colon. Rendered widths 28/40, 24/40, 34/40.

'Inactif' → 'Inactive' (8/24 cells). Feminine now agrees with the session and with the sibling 'Terminée'; the fr corpus uses the feminine for sessions ('supprimer les sessions inactives depuis…', 'si la cible est inactive').

Button label is now '«\u202fReprendre\u202f»' (U+00AB, U+202F, U+00BB), matching '«\u202fNouvelle\u202f»' in list.empty_hint and the fr guide. The sentence is now 'Envoyer un message ou « Reprendre » la rouvre dans votre dossier personnel' — two coordinated infinitives with singular 'la rouvre', grammatical; 74 cells, no maxCells.

findings.reason: Unchanged 19 cells vs maxCells 16, but the role is an accessible name only. Nothing is laid out, so no visible clipping is possible; 'Fermer' would fit but removes the object for screen-reader and voice-control users. Rendered/TTS confirmation remains with the rendered QA pass.

Unchanged 21/20. 'Tout marquer comme lu' is the established French form (the same file's row.mark_read uses 'Marquer comme lu'); the proposed 'Tout marquer lu' is not grammatical French. One cell over budget is a rendered-fit question, not a semantic defect.
Unchanged 11/10; 'Désépingler' is the only correct French term and pairs with the sibling 'Épingler'. Flagged for the action-sheet/swipe-tile render.
Unchanged 15/12; 'Enregistrement…' follows the guide's Enregistrer/Enregistré vocabulary and the existing busy-state noun pattern. 'Sauvegarde…' would fit but drift. Rendered fit pending.
Unchanged 30/28; bare 'Chargement…' would lose the object. Rendered fit in the centred loading state pending.

findings.verification: Fixed as 'Terminée · historique conservé' (30/32 cells). Semantics preserved: the session is ended and its history is kept; the adjective agrees with 'session' and matches the unchanged subtitle 'Terminée'. On the session banner the subject is unambiguous.

Fixed as 'Ne répond pas — les envois attendent' (36/36 cells). Present tense keeps the wait sense without asserting a queue; 'envois' is the locale's settled noun for message sends (relay.asks.status.delivering 'Répondu — envoi en cours'; wire.settings.send_journal_unconfirmed.label 'Journaliser les envois non acquittés').

safety_delta.approve: PASS — session.tray.approve 'Approuver' and session.tray.approve_label 'Approuver — une demande attend votre réponse' are byte-identical to the R1-audited target (carried forward).
safety_delta.ended_resume: PASS — session.ended now 'Terminée · historique conservé' and session.ended_hint 'Envoyer un message ou « Reprendre » la rouvre dans votre dossier personnel'; both preserve ended-but-kept and reopen-in-home-folder semantics, and session.resume/resuming are unchanged. No ambiguity introduced.
safety_delta.degraded: PASS — 'Ne répond pas — les envois attendent' still states sends wait; no delivery guarantee. session.subtitle.not_answering 'Ne répond pas' unchanged.
safety_delta.waiting: PASS — 'Vous attend' accurately renders 'Waiting for you'; consistent with the 'attend' verb in approve_label; 11/24 cells.
safety_delta.second_auditor_signoff: Not mine to claim; the separate safety auditor's delta signoff remains theirs.
